projectors.candidateCheck: Previously discussed candidate, retained for testing: enlarging the full portrait raster from 20 ft to 26 ft at a fixed center adds 3 ft at the top. At a 38–39 ft throw this needs approximately 1.46–1.50:1, within the ET-DLE150 range. A 20 ft mapped picture would use approximately 985 of 1280 portrait pixels. Wider black raster, spill and cove clearance need testing. A 28 ft raster is at the nominal wide limit near 38 ft; 4 ft extra is not promised.
projectors.installationCheck: Verify the current lens, full raster center, existing shift and cove opening. Panasonic specifies ET-LAD120P/PW portrait lamps and terminal-side-down mounting (DW830 specification, page 14); current installation has not been inspected for these items.

projectors.reviewPlan: Adam reviews Friday morning, November 6; choose and implement the change in time for Saturday morning, November 7. Confirm installed lens label, current zoom and portrait-up shift stop. Check the 38–39 ft lens throw, 20 ft-tall portrait raster and requested 3–4 ft upward coverage. Consider a roughly 26 ft raster with 20 ft content positioned high in Resolume (nominal ratio 1.46–1.50:1). Verify cove beam clearance and surface coverage first; brightness and resolution are secondary.
